name: continuity_3d_maze
description: Render furnished ProcTHOR houses as 3D mazes with labeled navigation points and ask either which candidate point-list is fully mutually connected, or which other labeled points are connected to a target point, under the shown door states.

connected_subset_choice.prompt: Which option lists two or more labeled points that are all mutually connected under the shown door states?

connected_point_list.prompt: List all other labeled points connected to point {source_name} under the shown door states.
connected_point_list.derive_answer: lex-sorted list of all other labeled points connected to the target point

difficulty_params.difficulty: Defined by setup tuple, or sampled by --difficulty in generation modes: easy uses (room_count 3, door_count 2, point_count 4); medium uses (4,3,4) or (5,4,4); hard uses (6,5,5) or (7,6,5).
difficulty_params.room_count: ProcTHOR room-count setup parameter controlled by --room-counts.
difficulty_params.door_count: Exact openable-door-count setup parameter controlled by --door-counts.
difficulty_params.point_count: Number of labeled navigation points controlled by --point-counts before question rows are emitted.
difficulty_params.door_state_mode: generated, open, closed, or random door states.

answer_evaluation: connected_subset_choice uses exact option matching; connected_point_list uses set-equality over parsed point-name lists.
